name: claude-oauth-proxy
description: OAuth proxy for Claude Pro/Max subscriptions - use your subscription as an API endpoint

secrets.name: ADMIN_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret key for admin endpoints (logout). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

post_deploy_message:
✅ Deployed! Next steps:
1. Create R2 bucket: npx wrangler r2 bucket create oauth-proxy-tokens
2. Set admin secret: npx wrangler secret put ADMIN_SECRET
3. Visit your Worker URL and click 'Login with Claude'
